description: Carly is an executive assistant for your email, CRM, and recurring work. Search and read your Gmail or Outlook, draft and send replies either from your own mailbox or from Carly's, and organize what arrives with folders, labels, and one-click unsubscribe. Keep contacts and CRM records current, look people up, and query your own structured data directly. Find free time across connected calendars, create and reschedule meetings, and share booking pages that respect your real availability. Build workflows that keep running after the conversation ends — a morning digest, inbox triage, a scheduled follow-up — then list, edit, run, and pause them from chat. Carly also handles to-dos, notes, files in Drive and OneDrive, and a searchable knowledge base of your own documents.
